# Media Mantra Consultancy FZCO

> Media Mantra Consultancy FZCO (also known as Media Mantra Consulting) is a PR and communications agency in Business Bay, Dubai. It offers media relations, public relations, reputation management, crisis communications, thought leadership, events, podcasts, content and digital marketing. Its clients include UAE brands, international brands entering the Middle East, and UAE brands expanding globally.

Key facts:

- Legal name: Media Mantra Consultancy FZCO (also known as Media Mantra Consulting)
- Type: PR and communications consultancy
- Dubai office: Office 615, 6th floor, Churchill Tower, Business Bay, Dubai, UAE
- Other offices: Gurugram, India (Ground floor, Plot 63, Sector 32, Gurugram 122001); Sydney, Australia (16 Earl Street, Hunters Hill, NSW 2110)
- Markets served: UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi), Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC; international brands entering the Middle East
- Leadership: Udit Pathak, recipient of the MDME 2026 Award for Excellence in PR & Communications Leadership and host of the "Pure Reality With Udit" podcast
- Sectors: real estate and property, technology and startups, fintech and financial services, consumer tech, B2B, hospitality, luxury and lifestyle, fashion, retail, sports, entertainment, and global/international PR
- Selected clients: boAt, Atlys, Centurion Properties, Amirah Developments, BAMX Developments, DECA Properties, AUM Development, BNW Developments, Blaupunkt, Liferay, Visionet, E2E Networks, Armaf, Virgio
- Media coverage: Khaleej Times, Gulf News, Campaign Middle East, Zawya, Adgully, exchange4media
- Approach: Strategy-led storytelling for positioning and brand narrative, PR and media strategy, and reputation and thought leadership
- Contact: info@mediamantraconsulting.com · UAE +971 56 179 1863 · India +91 99907 95002
- Related company: Media Mantra Global, the India-headquartered group agency (https://www.mediamantraglobal.com)
